howto.title: Draft your squad
howto.body: 12 rounds, 12 positions. Each round rolls a random country and WBC edition. Pick one player from that roster for your lineup; each player can only be drafted once.

howto.title: Two lifelines
howto.body: You get 1 country reroll (same edition) and 1 edition reroll (same country) per run. Spend them wisely: live with China 2009, or burn the reroll?

howto.title: Run the table
howto.body: 4 pool games, quarters, semis, the final. Win the tournament and you're CAMPEÓN 🏆. Win it all 7-0… that's INVICTO ⭐, the perfect run.

landing.heading: Invicto: the World Baseball Classic perfect-season game
landing.intro: Invicto is a free browser baseball game. Draft a 12-player lineup from real World Baseball Classic rosters (2006-2026) and simulate a 7-game tournament: win it all 7-0 for INVICTO, or win with one loss for CAMPEÓN. Ratings come from real statistics (Wikipedia and the SABR Lahman Baseball Database). Free, no account, in Spanish, English, Japanese and Korean.

footer.disclaimer: Invicto is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by the World Baseball Classic, WBCI, MLB, NPB, or any team or players' association. Player names and historical statistics are used as factual references.
footer.aboutText: Invicto is a tribute to the perfect-season game genre (the NBA's 82-0, MLB's 162-0). Roster data: Wikipedia. Stats: SABR Lahman Baseball Database. Made with love for Caribbean baseball fandom and the whole baseball world.

meta.title: Invicto: Can you run the table at the World Baseball Classic?
meta.description: Draft a lineup from real World Baseball Classic rosters (2006–2026) and try to win it all 7-0. Free, multilingual, three minutes a run.
